result.summary: The layout is largely sound, but there are visual inconsistencies in the 'Popular right now' cards — notably the favorite (heart) buttons use different styling/contrast between cards — plus a thumbnail that doesn't fill its card and some duplicated delivery-fee information.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the first uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the second uses a dark/near-black circle with a white heart. The dark variant blends into the darker image area and reads as a different (e.g. active) state, which is confusing and lowers contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment (e.g. translucent white circle with dark outlined heart) for all unfavorited cards, and reserve a distinct filled style only for the actual 'favorited' state.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel does not fill its card — a large light-gray background surrounds the small illustration, unlike the neighboring cards whose imagery fills the frame.
issues.suggestion: Scale/crop the image to cover the card area (object-fit: cover) so all carousel thumbnails have consistent visual weight.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the '€0 delivery' badge overlaid on the image repeats the '€0 delivery' text already shown in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the fee in only one place — keep the promotional badge on the image and omit it from the metadata row, or vice versa.

issues.description: The metadata line '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' has uneven separator spacing, with the bullets sitting tight against the preceding text and wide gaps after them.
issues.suggestion: Apply equal horizontal margins on both sides of the bullet separators for balanced spacing.
